1) The part-load performance characteristics of the reference electric chiller shall be adjusted for cooling capacity by applying Sentence (2) and adjusted for power draw by applying Sentence (4).
2) The available total cooling capacity, Qavailables in Btu/h, of the reference electric chiller as a function of present evaporator and condenser conditions shall be calculated using the following equation:
Qavailable = CAP_FTEC Qrated
where CAP_FTEC = cooling capacity adjustment determined in accordance with Sentence (3), and
Qrated = rated capacity at AHRI test conditions, in Btu/h.
3) The cooling capacity adjustment, CAP_FTEC, shall be calculated using the following equation:
CAP_FTEC = a + (b tchws) + (c X tchws²) + (d X tcwₛ) + (e tcws²) + (f tchws tcws)
where
tchwₛ = chilled water supply temperature, in °F, tcwₛ = condenser water supply temperature, in °F, and a,b,c,d,e, f = applicable coefficients from Table 8.4.6.5.-A.
Table 8.4.6.5.-A Capacity Coefficients Used in the Calculation of CAP_FTEC Forming Part of Sentence 8.4.6.5.(3)
4) The power draw at specified operating conditions, Poperating in kW, of the reference electric chiller as a function of present evaporator and condenser conditions and part-load ratio shall be calculated using the following equation:
Poperating = Pᵣₐₜₑd EIR_FPLR X EIR_FT CAP_FTE
where Pᵣₐₜₑd = rated power draw at AHRI test conditions, in kW,
EIR_FPLR = electric input ratio adjustment to rated efficiency due to changes in load determined in accordance with Sentence (5),
EIR_FT = electric input ratio adjustment to rated efficiency due to environmental variables determined in accordance with Sentence (7), and
CAP_FTEC = cooling capacity adjustment determined in accordance with Sentence (3).
5) The electric input ratio adjustment to the rated efficiency due to changes in load, EIR_FPLR, shall be calculated using the following equation:
EIR_FPLR = a + X PLR) + (c PLR²)
where
PLR = part-load ratio based on available capacity (not rated capacity) determined in accordance with Sentence (6), and
a, b, C = applicable coefficients from Table 8.4.6.5.-B.
Table 8.4.6.5.-B Efficiency Coefficients Used in the Calculation of EIR_FPLR Forming Part of Sentence 8.4.6.5.(5)
6) The part-load ratio based on available capacity, PLR, shall be calculated using the following equation:
PLR = Qoperating Qavailable
where Qoperating = present load on electric chiller, in Btu/h, and Qavailable = available capacity of electric chiller at present evaporator and condenser conditions, in Btu/h, determined in accordance with Sentence (2).
7) The electric input ratio adjustment to the rated efficiency due to environmental variables, EIR_FT, shall be calculated using the following equation:
EIR_FT = a + (b tchws) + chws²) + (d tcwₛ) + (e tcwₛ²) + (f tchws tcws)
where
tchwₛ = chilled water supply temperature, in °F, tᶜwₛ = condenser water supply temperature, in °F, and a, b, c,d, e, f = applicable coefficients from Table 8.4.6.5.-C.
